primitives.name: Weekend Warrior Physical Activity Concentration
primitives.verbatim_quote: Participants were classified as inactive (< 150 min/week of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity [MVPA]), weekend warriors ( ≥ 150 min/week with ≥ 50% of MVPA accumulated within 1 - 2 days), or regularly active ( ≥ 150 min/week with ≥ 50% distributed across > 2 days).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D_{\\text{active}}': 'set of active days in week', 'D_{\\text{WW}}': 'set of weekend warrior days', 'D': 'set of all days in week', 'MVPA_d': 'moderate-to-vigorous physical activity on day \\( d \\), \\( \\text{min} \\)'}
primitives.assumptions: Activity is measured via wrist-worn accelerometry; MVPA is defined as \( \geq 3.0 \, \text{METs} \); weekly distribution is modeled as deterministic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( \sum_{d \in D_{\text{WW}}} \text{MVPA}_d < 0.5 \cdot \sum_{d \in D} \text{MVPA}_d \), WW pattern fails to meet criteria.

layer2.mapping: Weekend warrior pattern \( \mathcal{P}_{\text{WW}} \) is isomorphic to a subset of \( \mathcal{P}_{\text{regular}} \) under constraint of \( \sum_{d \in D_{\text{WW}}} \text{MVPA}_d \geq 0.5 \cdot \sum_{d \in D} \text{MVPA}_d \).
layer2.telemetry: Proportion of MVPA accumulated in 1–2 days relative to total weekly MVPA.

primitives.name: Osteoarthritis Incidence Hazard Ratio
primitives.verbatim_quote: In contrast, compared with regularly active participants, weekend warrior participants did not show a statistically significant difference in OA risk (HR, 1.031; 95% CI, 0.968 - 1.099), even after further adjustment for total MVPA volume.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\lambda_{\\text{WW}}': 'incidence rate of OA in weekend warriors, \\( \\text{cases/year} \\)', '\\lambda_{\\text{regular}}': 'incidence rate of OA in regularly active participants, \\( \\text{cases/year} \\)', '\\text{HR}': 'hazard ratio, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Cox proportional hazards model holds; HR is constant over time; baseline hazard is shared.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( \text{HR} \not\approx 1 \), hazard ratio indicates increased or decreased risk.

layer2.mapping: Hazard ratio \( \text{HR} \) derived from \( \lambda_{\text{WW}} \) and \( \lambda_{\text{regular}} \) via survival analysis kernel.
layer2.telemetry: Cox regression HR with 95% CI from cohort data.

primitives.name: Weekly Physical Activity Volume Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: Participants were classified as inactive (< 150 min/week of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity [MVPA]), weekend warriors ( ≥ 150 min/week with ≥ 50% of MVPA accumulated within 1 - 2 days), or regularly active ( ≥ 150 min/week with ≥ 50% distributed across > 2 days).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{P}': 'set of physical activity patterns', 'D': 'set of days in week', '\\text{MVPA}_d': 'moderate-to-vigorous physical activity on day \\( d \\), \\( \\text{min} \\)'}
primitives.assumptions: Volume threshold is fixed at 150 min/week; MVPA is aggregated over 7-day period.

layer2.mapping: Volume constraint \( \sum_{d \in D} \text{MVPA}_d \geq 150 \) defines a subspace of \( \mathcal{P} \) where \( \mathcal{P}_{\text{WW}}, \mathcal{P}_{\text{regular}} \subset \mathcal{P} \).
layer2.telemetry: Total weekly MVPA volume from accelerometer data.

The core operator \( \mathcal{P} \) maps activity patterns to risk \( R \), with \( \mathcal{P} = \{\text{inactive}, \text{WW}, \text{RA}\} \). The temporal concentration \( C \) of MVPA within \( \mathcal{P} \) is a key variable: WW pattern implies \( C \in [0.5, 1] \), while RA implies \( C \leq 0.5 \). The hazard ratio \( \text{HR} \) quantifies the relative risk of OA between WW and RA groups. The mathematical framework assumes proportional hazards and uses Cox regression to estimate \( \text{HR} = 1.031 \pm 0.065 \), indicating no significant difference in OA risk. The failure mode occurs when \( C \) exceeds 0.5 but \( \text{HR} \neq 1 \), suggesting potential injury or overuse. The dual nature of \( \mathcal{P} \) lies in its temporal structure: \( \mathcal{P}_{\text{WW}} \) is a subset of \( \mathcal{P}_{\text{RA}} \) under volume constraint. The epistemic trace reveals that \( \mathcal{P} \) is a structured space of activity regimes, with \( \text{HR} \) acting as a metric on this space.
